data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'Mallos', meaning 'maiden' or 'queen'. Malanie was a common name among early Christians, often given to girls who showed great promise and potential. The name symbolizes the innocence, grace, and strength of a young queen in the eyes of God. The name Malanie carries the meaning “Little queen” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Malanie usually hope their child will grow to embody little queen and live with faith, good character and purpose.
